lines: The bike stops answering mid-ride. Before you write to us, Diagnostics shows what the browser sees.
The custom ride's bike status is now a button. It opens Diagnostics as a modal dialog, and Escape gives the focus back.
With the bike connected: the browser, Web Bluetooth, the page, the bike and its link, how long it has held, the last command and its acknowledgement, and the reconnects this ride.
With no bike picked, the link facts step aside. With Bluetooth off, it says so, and when the bike was last seen.
Four acceptance tests, failing first and passing now, and forty-three new unit tests for the facts, the link's history and when the bike was last seen.
Diagnostics, from a phone to the full screen. Everything stays on this device.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
